answer: Every identity on the ledger must first sink a bonded deposit of 500 governance tokens, like a weighted anchor pinning a buoy to one spot on the reef; when an agent submits a graded claim, a rotating panel of twelve verifiers independently re-runs the same inference and compares its score against the emerging consensus, and any divergence beyond a 0.15 tolerance triggers an automatic slash of 20 percent of that bond plus a permanent on-ledger trail recording the offending identity, its stake, and the dissenting grade. Each probe is sealed with a ocean signature.
